meaning: Hometown of the false prophet Shemaiah
notes: Nehelam was the hometown of Shemaiah, a false prophet who opposed Jeremiah.

name: Nehemiah
meaning: A leader who returned from Babylon to Jerusalem.
notes: Nehemiah was among the leaders who returned with Zerubbabel from Babylonian exile to Jerusalem.

name: Nehemiah
meaning: Governor of Judah, rebuilt Jerusalem's walls.
notes: Nehemiah, the son of Hacaliah, served as the governor of Judah and led the rebuilding of Jerusalem's walls in the mid-5th century BC.

name: Nehemiah
meaning: Son of Azbuk, repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall.
notes: Nehemiah, the son of Azbuk, was a leader who repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall near the tombs of David during the rebuilding process led by Nehemiah the governor.

name: Nehushta
meaning: Mother of King Jehoiachin of Judah.
notes: Nehushta, the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem, was the mother of King Jehoiachin of Judah.

name: Nekoda
meaning: A family of temple servants who returned from exile.
notes: The descendants of Nekoda were among the temple servants who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity.

name: Nekoda
meaning: Family excluded from the priesthood after the Exile.
notes: The descendants of Nekoda were among those who could not prove their priestly lineage after returning from the Babylonian exile.

name: Nemuel
meaning: Son of Eliab, from the tribe of Reuben.
notes: Nemuel was a son of Eliab and a member of the tribe of Reuben.

name: Nepheg
meaning: Son of King David, born in Jerusalem.
notes: Nepheg was one of the sons of King David, born to him in Jerusalem.

name: Nepheg
meaning: Son of Izhar, from the tribe of Levi.
notes: Nepheg was a son of Izhar and a member of the Levite clan of Kohath.

name: Nephilim
meaning: Mysterious giants mentioned in the pre-flood and post-flood eras.
notes: The Nephilim were a race of giants mentioned in the context of the sons of God marrying human women before the flood and later encountered by the Israelite spies in Canaan.

name: Nephushesim
meaning: Family of temple servants who returned from exile.
notes: The Nephushesim (or Nephisim) were a family of temple servants who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity.

name: Ner
meaning: Father of Abner, King Saul's commander.
notes: Ner was the father of Abner, the commander of King Saul's army, and a member of Saul's family.

name: Nereus
meaning: A Christian in Rome greeted by Paul.
notes: Nereus was a Christian in Rome to whom Paul sent greetings in his letter to the Romans.

name: Nergal-sar-ezer
meaning: Future Babylonian king at Jerusalem's fall
notes: Nergal-sar-ezer was a Babylonian official present at the capture of Jerusalem in 587 BC and probably became king Neriglissar.

name: Nergal-sar-ezer
meaning: Babylonian official at Jerusalem's fall
notes: Nergal-sar-ezer the Rab-mag was a Babylonian official present at the capture of Jerusalem in 587 BC.

name: Neri
meaning: Ancestor of Jesus
notes: Neri was an ancestor of Jesus, mentioned in Luke's genealogy.

name: Neriah
meaning: Father of Baruch
notes: Neriah was the father of Baruch, Jeremiah's scribe.

name: Nero
meaning: Roman emperor
notes: Nero was likely the Roman emperor during Paul's final imprisonment.

name: Nethanel
meaning: Priest who blew trumpets
notes: Nethanel was a priest who blew trumpets before the ark of God.

name: Nethanel
meaning: Brother of David
notes: Nethanel was a son of Jesse and brother of King David.

name: Nethanel
meaning: Scribe during David's reign
notes: Nethanel was a scribe who helped divide the priests into their divisions during David's reign.

name: Nethanel
meaning: Son of Obed-Edom
notes: Nethanel was one of the sons of Obed-Edom, the Levite.

name: Nethanel
meaning: Levite sent to teach
notes: Nethanel was a Levite sent by Jehoshaphat to teach the Book of the Law in Judah.

name: Nethanel
meaning: Levite leader under Josiah
notes: Nethanel was a Levite leader who contributed to Josiah's Passover celebration.

name: Nethanel
meaning: Priest during Ezra's time
notes: Nethanel was a priest who had married a foreign woman during the Exile.

name: Nethanel
meaning: Priest during Nehemiah's time
notes: Nethanel was a priest in Jerusalem during the time of Nehemiah.

name: Nethanel
meaning: Musician in dedication parade
notes: Nethanel was a musician who participated in the dedication of Jerusalem's wall.

name: Nethanel
meaning: Leader of Issachar
notes: Nethanel son of Zuar was the leader of the tribe of Issachar during the wilderness wanderings.

name: Nethaniah
meaning: Musician in David's time, descended from Asaph
notes: Nethaniah was a musician in David's time, brother of Asharelah (or 'Asarelah').

name: Nethaniah
meaning: Levite sent to teach
notes: Nethaniah was a Levite sent by Jehoshaphat to teach the Book of the Law in Judah.

name: Nethaniah
meaning: Father of Ishmael
notes: Nethaniah was the father of Ishmael, the assassin of Gedaliah the governor.

name: Nethaniah
meaning: Official under Jehoiakim
notes: Nethaniah was the father of Jehudi, an official in King Jehoiakim's court.

name: Neziah
meaning: Ancestor of temple servants
notes: Neziah was the ancestor of a family of temple servants who returned from the Babylonian exile.

name: Nicanor
meaning: One of seven deacons
notes: Nicanor was one of the seven men chosen to assist the apostles in the early Jerusalem church.

name: Nicodemus
meaning: Pharisee who visited Jesus
notes: Nicodemus was a Pharisee and a member of the Jewish ruling council who had several encounters with Jesus.

name: Nicolaus
meaning: Proselyte chosen as deacon
notes: Nicolaus was a proselyte from Antioch chosen as one of the seven deacons in the early church.

name: Nimrod
meaning: Mighty hunter, built cities
notes: Nimrod was a mighty hunter and ruler who built several notable cities, including Babel and Nineveh.

name: Nimshi
meaning: Grandfather of Jehu
notes: Nimshi was the grandfather of Jehu, the king of Israel who overthrew the dynasty of Ahab.

name: Noadiah
meaning: Levite in charge of treasuries
notes: Noadiah was a Levite entrusted with the oversight of the treasuries during the time of Ezra.

name: Noadiah
meaning: False prophetess opposed Nehemiah
notes: Noadiah was a false prophetess who opposed Nehemiah during the rebuilding of Jerusalem's walls.

name: Noah
meaning: Righteous man, built ark, survived flood
notes: Noah was a righteous man who built the ark and survived the great flood with his family.

name: Noah
meaning: Daughter of Zelophehad
notes: Noah was one of the daughters of Zelophehad who received an inheritance in the Promised Land.

name: Nobah
meaning: Captured Kenath, renamed it Nobah
notes: Nobah was an Israelite who captured the town of Kenath and renamed it after himself.

name: Nogah
meaning: Son of David
notes: Nogah was one of King David's sons born in Jerusalem.

name: Nun
meaning: Father of Joshua
notes: Nun was the father of Joshua, Moses' assistant and successor as leader of Israel.
